_note: Byte-aligned locks for the web tools, now TS-faithful: WebFetch caps the TRANSFER at 10 MB (MAX_HTTP_CONTENT_LENGTH, utils.ts:112) and the converted MARKDOWN at 100k chars (MAX_MARKDOWN_LENGTH, utils.ts:128) — the prior single 5 MB body cap was a divergence and has been removed. Event names follow the M3-06 lock (_completed suffix, not _succeeded). error_templates.http_status is now the `iIp` SUCCESS-result body (status sentence + body note) returned for HTTP >= 400 — claude-code does NOT throw on >= 400; {status_text} comes from the Node/bun STATUS_CODES table (`status_reason_phrase`).

error_templates.http_status:
The server returned HTTP {status} {status_text}.

The response body was not retrieved. If this URL requires authentication, use an authenticated tool (e.g. `gh` for GitHub, or an MCP-provided fetch tool) instead of WebFetch.
